data.name: Eeshaal
data.gender_notes: Eeshaal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eeshaal is derived from the Arabic root 'ishal' which means to make something easy or to facilitate. It is related to the concept of living a life of ease and comfort. The name Eeshaal carries the meaning “Living a luxurious life” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Eeshaal usually hope their child will grow to embody living a luxurious life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, Eeshaal can be related to the concept of being blessed with a comfortable and easy life, as mentioned in the Quran, 'And if they had believed and been mindful of Allah, His reward would have been better for them, if they only knew.' (Quran 2:103)
data.etymology: Eeshaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Living a luxurious life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eeshaal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
